app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

in_library.description: InLibrary is always false for the shared guest session.

play_count.description: PlayCount is the app's displayed play count where the route carries it.

protagonist.description: Protagonist lists the cast names as the app prints them.

shelf_time.description: ShelfTime is the app's listing time as printed ("2026-09-27 16:42:18").

shelf_time_ms.description: ShelfTimeMS is the same listing time as Unix milliseconds.

tag_refs.description: TagRefs pairs each tag with its id; pass an id to dramabox-tag.

url.description: URL is the public DramaBox website page for the title.

listed_at.description:
ListedAt is the site's first-listing timestamp as printed
("2026-10-24 10:00:00"); its time zone is not stated by the site.

status.description: Status is the site's update label, for example "Completed".

views_display.description:
ViewsDisplay is the view count as the site prints it ("15.6K"); it is
empty where the list does not carry one.

key.description: Key is language, production, dub, genre_1, genre_2 or sort.

row.description:
Row is the genre row index for the two type-4 groups (0 then 1). It is
zero/omitted for every other group.

type.description:
Type is the upstream classify type id (1, 6, 2, 4, 4, 5 respectively,
in the order above).

free.description: Free is true for episodes the site unlocks without payment.

rank_type.description: RankType echoes the requested tab; 0 means the default tab was used.

tabs.description:
Tabs are the ranking tabs the app API offers; pass a tab's type as
rank_type to read that list.

titles.description: Titles holds the ranking list (fixed at 20 titles upstream).

type.description: Type is the value to pass as rank_type.

data_from.description: DataFrom is the app's recommendation-source label.

in_library.description:
InLibrary reports whether the title is in the caller's library, which
for a guest session is always false.

position.description: Position is the title's ordinal in the ranking (1-based).

protagonist.description: Protagonist lists the cast names as the app prints them.

shelf_time.description: ShelfTime is the app's listing time as printed ("2026-09-27 16:42:18").

shelf_time_ms.description: ShelfTimeMS is the same listing time as Unix milliseconds.

url.description: URL is the public DramaBox website page for the title.

page_size.description:
PageSize is the upstream page size (the route takes no page-size
parameter, so callers cannot choose it).

avatar.description:
Avatar is the performer image URL the app serves (jpg); it is catalogue
artwork, not playable media.

videos.description: Videos is the number of series the performer appears in.

is_more.description:
HasMore is the answer's isMore flag (the app API's totalSize is not
usable: it answers 0 even when more pages exist).

keyword.description: Keyword echoes the normalized keyword that was searched.

position.description:
Position is the dramabox-more position that lists this shelf in full:
trending, must-sees or hidden-gems; empty for an unknown shelf.

avatar.description: Avatar is the performer image (jpg) for kind "actor".

cover_url.description: CoverURL is the book cover image (jpg) for kind "book".

videos.description: Videos is the performer's series count for kind "actor".

has_more.description: HasMore reports whether the recommendation block has another page.

new_releases.description: NewReleases is the app's new-release list.

preset_keyword.description: PresetKeyword is the word the app pre-fills in its search box.

rank_tabs.description:
RankTabs are the ranking tabs; a tab's type is a valid rank_type for
dramabox-rank.

trending.description: Trending is the app's trending list.

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.
info.title: Crawlora API

get.description: Returns one page of 12 DramaBox short dramas, optionally within one genre: id, title, description, cover, link, episode count, tags, genres, rating, update status and displayed views, with the page and total page count. Genre ids come from dramabox-genres. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

parameters.description: Genre id from dramabox-genres; 0 or omitted browses all titles
parameters.name: genre_id

parameters.description: Page number, 1 to 1000; defaults to 1. Each page holds 12 titles
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Site locale, one of: en, ko, zhHans, zh, es, ja, de, in, th, tl, pt, fr, ar, it (in is Indonesian); defaults to en. Each locale has its own title library
parameters.name: language

get.summary: Browse DramaBox short dramas by genre

get.description: Returns the DramaBox app's category navigation as six groups: language, production type, dub mode, two genre rows (genre_1 and genre_2) and sort order. Each group lists the selectable options as display names and the values to pass to dramabox-category-books. The "All" pseudo-option is dropped because omitting a filter means all. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

Returns one page of 20 DramaBox short dramas from the app's category feed, optionally filtered by values from dramabox-categories: language, production type, dub mode, either genre row and sort order. Filters are ANDed; an omitted filter means all. Each title carries its id, title, description, cover, website link, episode count, tags with tag ids, protagonist, play count, library flag and listing times. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

parameters.description: Language/origin value from dramabox-categories' language group, e.g. 美国 (Local) or 中国 (Chinese)
parameters.name: language

parameters.description: Production-type value from dramabox-categories' production group: 3 (AI Drama), 1 (Live-Action), 2 (Anime)
parameters.name: production

parameters.description: Dub-mode value from dramabox-categories' dub group: 1 (Dubbed), 0 (Subtitles Only)
parameters.name: dub

parameters.description: Genre value from dramabox-categories' genre_1 group, e.g. 1357 (Romance) or 1361 (Strong Heroine)
parameters.name: genre

parameters.description: Genre value from dramabox-categories' genre_2 group, e.g. 1392 (Second Chance) or 1359 (BL); multi-tag values such as 1324,1362 are one value
parameters.name: genre_2

parameters.description: Sort value from dramabox-categories' sort group: 1 (Trending), 2 (Latest), 3 (Unwatched)
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Page number, 1 to 1000; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Titles per page, 1 to 50; defaults to 20
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns the 8 DramaBox app theater channels as ids and names: Popular, New, Rankings, Categories, Anime, Live-Action, VIP and Original+. The channel value for dramabox-theater is the lowercase name (popular, new, rankings, categories, anime, live-action, vip, original). Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

Returns one DramaBox short drama: title, description, cover, link, language, episode count, lifetime views, follows, tags, genres, listing times, the languages it is available in, the episode list with each episode's number, id, duration, free flag and thumbnail, and related titles. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

parameters.description: Title id (digits) from any DramaBox list, or a dramabox.com drama URL
parameters.name: id

get.summary: Get a DramaBox short drama and its episodes

get.description: Returns the genres DramaBox's browse accepts (Romance, Werewolves, Revenge, Billionaire, ...) as ids and names, read live from DramaBox. Pass a genre id to dramabox-browse. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

parameters.description: Site locale, one of: en, ko, zhHans, zh, es, ja, de, in, th, tl, pt, fr, ar, it (in is Indonesian); defaults to en. Each locale has its own title library
parameters.name: language

get.description: Returns DramaBox's (dramabox.com) home page: the featured short dramas and the three curated shelves (Trending, Must-sees, Hidden gems), each title with its id, title, description, cover, DramaBox link, episode count, tags, genres and the view count as the site prints it. Use dramabox-more for a whole shelf. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

parameters.description: Site locale, one of: en, ko, zhHans, zh, es, ja, de, in, th, tl, pt, fr, ar, it (in is Indonesian); defaults to en. Each locale has its own title library
parameters.name: language

get.summary: List DramaBox's featured titles and shelves

get.description: Returns one page of 18 titles from a DramaBox curated shelf (trending, must-sees or hidden-gems): id, title, description, cover, link, episode count, tags, genres and displayed views, with the page and total page count. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

parameters.description: Curated shelf: trending, must-sees or hidden-gems
parameters.name: position

parameters.description: Page number, 1 to 1000; defaults to 1. Each page holds 18 titles
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Site locale, one of: en, ko, zhHans, zh, es, ja, de, in, th, tl, pt, fr, ar, it (in is Indonesian); defaults to en. Each locale has its own title library
parameters.name: language

get.summary: Get a whole DramaBox curated shelf

get.description: Returns one DramaBox performer from the Android app API: name, gender, avatar, video count, follow flag, and one page of the titles they appear in (each with id, title, description, cover, website link, episode count, tags with their tag ids, protagonist, library flag and listing times). Get performer ids from dramabox-search or dramabox-suggest's people results. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

parameters.description: Performer id from dramabox-search or dramabox-suggest's people results
parameters.name: performer_id

parameters.description: Page number, 1 to 1000; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 20; defaults to 10
parameters.name: limit

get.summary: Get a DramaBox performer and their titles

get.description: Returns one DramaBox ranking list from the DramaBox Android app API: the available tabs (Most Trending, Top Searched, New Releases) and 20 ranked titles, each with its id, title, description, cover, website link, episode count, tags, protagonist, rank position, hot metric, library flag and listing times. Pass a tab's type as rank_type to read that tab. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

parameters.description: Ranking tab: 1 (Most Trending), 2 (Top Searched), 3 (New Releases); omit for the default tab
parameters.name: rank_type

get.description: Returns one page of DramaBox's own "You Might Like" recommendation feed from the Android app API: the feed title and its titles, each with id, title, description, cover, website link, episode count, tags with their tag ids, protagonist, library flag and listing times. The upstream page size is fixed, so page is the only paging control. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

parameters.description: Page number, 1 to 1000; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

get.summary: Get a page of DramaBox's recommendation feed

get.description: Searches the DramaBox Android app API and returns one page of mixed results: book rows (id, title, description, cover, website link, tags, protagonist) and performer rows (id, name, avatar, series count), plus an is_more flag for the next page. The keyword is trimmed and truncated to 80 characters like the app; sort selects one of the app's result orderings. Performer ids can be passed to dramabox-performer. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

parameters.description: Search text, trimmed and truncated to 80 characters
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.description: One-based result page
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Results per page
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Upstream result ordering mode; omit for the app default
parameters.name: sort

get.description: Returns the DramaBox Android app API's autocomplete suggestions for a partial query: book rows (kind "book", cover_url) and performer rows (kind "actor", avatar, series count). The keyword is trimmed and truncated to 80 characters like the app; a query with no match returns an empty items list. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

parameters.description: Partial search text, trimmed and truncated to 80 characters
parameters.name: keyword

get.description: Returns one page of DramaBox titles carrying a tag, as the Android app shows them: each title's id, title, description, cover, website link, episode count, tags with their tag ids, protagonist, library flag and listing times, plus the tag's own name. Get tag ids from any title result's tag_refs (dramabox-rank, dramabox-search, dramabox-category-books and the other list endpoints all expose them). An unknown tag id returns an empty list rather than an error. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

parameters.description: Tag id from any title result's tag_refs
parameters.name: tag_id

parameters.description: Page number, 1 to 1000; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 50; defaults to 20
parameters.name: limit

get.summary: List the DramaBox titles carrying a tag

get.description: Returns one page of a DramaBox app theater channel: the channel, its titled shelves (each with styles and 10 to 20 titles), poster banners and search hot words. Each title carries its id, title, description, cover, website link, episode count, tags with tag ids, protagonist, play count, library flag and listing times. Channel values are the lowercase names from dramabox-channels. An empty feed is a valid answer. Only public catalog metadata and poster images are read; no playable video is returned.

parameters.description: Theater channel: popular, new, rankings, categories, anime, live-action, vip or original
parameters.name: channel

parameters.description: Page number, 1 to 1000; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Titles per paged block, 1 to 20; defaults to 10
parameters.name: limit

get.summary: Get a DramaBox theater channel feed

get.description: Returns the DramaBox Android app API's search landing page: the hot, trending and new-release title lists, the ranking tabs (pass a tab's type to dramabox-rank as rank_type) and the app's preset search keyword. Takes no parameters. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.
